label: QuickBooks
specifics: QuickBooks users most often leave over per-user subscription cost and over paying for an accounting depth they never use. Be concrete about what a small trading or services business actually needs.

label: Zoho Books
specifics: Zoho Books users are usually already inside a wider suite, so the honest section 3 is about staying if the rest of the suite is what holds the business together.

label: Xero
specifics: Xero is strong on bank reconciliation and on its accountant network. Section 3 must say plainly that a business whose accountant works exclusively in Xero should weigh that heavily.

label: Tally
specifics: Tally is desktop-first and deeply embedded in South Asian bookkeeping practice. The honest section 3 is about businesses whose accountant and whose statutory filings are built around it.

label: Wave
specifics: Wave users are typically freelancers and very small businesses already on a free plan, so the gain has to be about growing past invoicing into stock, modules and other languages, not about price.

label: Sage
specifics: Sage covers a wide product family from small business to mid-market. Section 3 must acknowledge that a business already on a Sage payroll or industry product has real switching cost.
